record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare RECOVER in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, max HP, range and passive.
record.summary: The caster heals itself by a percentage of its own current max HP (25 % at 1 and 2 stars, 50 % at 3 stars, 100 % fallback for 4+) through handleHeal with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag. Because requiresTarget is false it can be cast without a target in range. The requested amount is scaled by AP (x(1 + AP/100)) and, only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false), by critPower; the applied amount is then changed by the heal helper's own rules (a wounded or protected caster receives nothing, x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP). No damage, status, movement or shield.

targeting.note: requiresTarget = false, so the cast does not need a target in range; the cast target is not used.

declaredRaw.label: requested heal = percent of the caster's current max HP

effects.scaling: requested = percent/100 x pokemon.maxHP; then AP: x(1 + AP/100) because apBoost is 1; then x critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (canCritByDefault false, so this needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied: the caster gets 0 if it is wounded (status.wound; with BLOODMOON weather and the player's BLOOD_STONE items a shield of round(0.3 x stones x requested heal) is requested instead), or at 0 hp, or protected; otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP (maxHP - hp). The uncapped excess (overheal) adds 0.4 x overheal max HP if the caster has the GRASS synergy effect. Requested, applied (healReceived) and overheal are separate amounts; the strategy ignores the returned values.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 1 and 2 stars heal the same 25 %; the 4-star value (100 %, also the fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. maxPP, range and max HP are in appliesTo / the unit blocks.

record.positionalConditions: None: the strategy reads no coordinates.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and heals once; healing is capped by missing HP, so a cast at full HP produces only overheal.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 25 % (1 and 2 stars) or 50 % (3 stars) of the caster's current max HP, x(1 + AP/100) [x critPower if the cast crit]. Applied: after the heal helper's reductions and multipliers and the cap at missing HP; the applied amount can be 0 (wound, protect) and never exceeds missing HP.
